    if dt.tzinfo is None:
        # Naive input: assume it is already UTC.
        return dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    # Offset-aware input: shift the instant to UTC (wall clock time changes).
    return dt.astimezone(timezone.utc)
